snippet.title: The House Always Wins - new rougelike deckbuilder trailer!
snippet.description:
Try the demo for free on Steam!
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4601260/The_House_Always_Wins/
Demo (free): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4664020/The_House_Always_Wins_Demo

STACK THE ODDS. BEAT THE HOUSE!
The House Always Wins is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a bizarre multiverse casino where every run is built on clever choices, powerful synergies, and calculated chaos.

Build your deck, battle through strange worlds, and collect relics in the form of playing cards. Each relic has its own unique effect, but the real power lies in the combinations you create. Form classic poker hands like pairs, three of a kind, or full houses to unlock massive bonuses, then experiment to uncover secret combos hidden throughout the game. You are not just building a deck — you are building a winning hand.

HERO POWER - CONTROLLED RANDOMNESS
Your hero’s signature power is a die you can roll once per turn. The result is random, but the decision is yours. After each roll, choose which card to empower for the rest of the battle, adapt your strategy to the number you get, and build around cards and relics that let you manipulate the odds. In The House Always Wins, randomness creates meaningful choices instead of taking control away.

QUESTS
Quests add another layer to every run, giving you optional objectives, valuable rewards, and new reasons to change your plan on the fly. They make each journey more dynamic, more strategic, and more replayable.

Funny, strange, and dangerous, The House sits at the center of the multiverse — and it never plays fair. Master the synergies, outsmart the odds, and prove that this time, the House does not win.

Despite the casino theme, the game contains no gambling mechanics — only strategy, synergies, and replayability.
